issues.title: Reload midway clears every answer and restarts contact collection
issues.actual: Step 1 returns with blank name, phone, email and default Colombia; no resume indication.
issues.expected: Restore draft or offer a clear way to resume the saved request.

issues.title: Obviously malformed full name is saved and advances
steps: Use name 123<>!!! with valid Mexican phone and email
issues.actual: Request succeeds and advances to clinic questions.
issues.expected: Reject a name consisting only of digits/punctuation with an actionable message.

issues.title: Network failure shows untranslated Failed to fetch without retry guidance
steps: Abort one local /api/contact request as disconnected
issues.actual: The Spanish form shows only Failed to fetch; entered data remains and retry works via the same button.
issues.expected: Explain in Spanish that sending failed, retain data, and invite retry.

issues.title: Final submission leaves the outcome above the viewport
steps: Double click Ver mis siguientes pasos
issues.actual: The final form disappears, but viewport remains near the footer with only bottom of blue panel; outcome text is above screen.
issues.expected: Move focus/scroll to the new result heading so the user sees confirmation and next action.

issues.title: Final disposition promises resources with no explanation or next step
steps: Use owner profile, 2 chairs, prefer not to disclose revenue, no lab/technology, 1–3 month timing
issues.actual: Por ahora Elevator Web quizá no sea el paso más adecuado; data saved to share resources. Only Volver al inicio; no reason or review route, resource link, or expected reply time.
issues.expected: Explain disposition without hidden scoring assumptions and provide a clear review/contact/resource next action.

issues.title: Website step accepts a javascript URL and advances
steps: Step4 choose Sí for existing website
issues.actual: Step5 opens; returning retains invalid scheme. Corrected to https://example.com before final submission.
issues.expected: Reject non-HTTP(S) website schemes at this step.
